title: Inventory classifies typed proficiency fields as model-adjudicated
description: After eshyra-olc5.7.1, the semi-structured boundary inventory (docs/inventories/o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.*) lists proficiency typed fields (mechanics.effects[].skills[], savingThrows[], armor[]; option mechanics.effects[] kind/grant/skills[]) as model-adjudicated with the generic string-shape note. They are validated fail-closed by kindSchemas.ts (closed vocabularies), so the disposition should be complete with a typedSchemaOrConsumer reference. Fix the classifier in packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts and regenerate the inventory.
